title: 习近平为AI注入文明：技术发展不侵蚀多样性，人类共同价值观如何塑造AI？
speaker: Xi Jinping

segments.en: Third, we should encourage inclusiveness and promote mutual learning between civilizations.
segments.zh: 第三，我们要鼓励包容，促进文明互鉴。

segments.en: AI development and its application should not erode or undermine the diversity of world civilizations, or the uniqueness of cultures of different countries.
segments.zh: 人工智能的发展和应用不应侵蚀或削弱世界文明的多样性，以及不同国家文化的独特性。

segments.en: We must shape the values of AI with humanity's common values and make good use of AI technologies.
segments.zh: 我们要用人类共同价值观塑造人工智能的价值观，善用人工智能技术。

segments.en: To increase understanding, tolerance, exchanges, and sharing among all civilizations.
segments.zh: 增进各文明之间的理解、包容、交流和共享。

segments.en: we should tend to make our own civilizations with great care to ensure that the beauty of each civilization is appreciated and shared.
segments.zh: 我们要精心呵护自己的文明，确保每种文明之美都能被欣赏和共享。

segments.en: Fourth, we should advocate solidarity and improve global governance.
segments.zh: 第四，我们要倡导团结，完善全球治理。
